dependency_version_policy.reason: The established candidate uses bounded compatible version ranges. P6-04 does not change post-freeze runtime dependencies merely to create a new lock.

dependency_version_policy.limitation: Exact third-party patch versions may differ across future resolver dates; any incompatibility must be treated as a reproducibility failure rather than silently patched.
